_comment: Topic backlog for the autonomous content pipeline (scripts/generate-content.mjs). Each run builds the FIRST entry whose slug is not yet present in its collection, then stops. When every slug already exists, the run is a clean no-op (no fabrication). Add long-tail eBay-repricing topics here to extend the runway. Keep angles specific so generated pages stay non-thin and non-duplicative.

topics.title: eBay Repricing for Sneakers & Streetwear
topics.angle: How resellers of sneakers and hyped streetwear should set floors and repricing aggressiveness when comps swing hard around release hype and condition (DS vs used) matters.

topics.title: eBay Repricing for Auto Parts & Accessories
topics.angle: Fitment-sensitive, often-OEM auto-parts listings: how to floor for core charges/shipping weight and reprice without matching mis-listed competitor parts.

topics.title: eBay Repricing for Trading Cards & TCG
topics.angle: Pokemon/sports/Magic singles where market price moves daily; floors keyed to grading cost and the difference between graded and raw.

topics.title: eBay Repricing for Part-Time & Weekend Sellers
topics.angle: Sellers with under 100 listings and a day job: how automated repricing with a floor wins sales while they're at work, on the free or Starter plan.

topics.title: How Much Should You Undercut Competitors on eBay?
topics.angle: The economics of the undercut amount — when $0.01 below is enough, when a percentage undercut makes sense, and how the floor caps the race.

topics.title: Does eBay Repricing Software Pay for Itself?
topics.angle: A worked ROI model: extra sell-through and recovered margin from staying at the top of search vs. a $29/mo subscription cost, with break-even listing counts.

topics.title: Repricing Used & Pre-Owned Items on eBay
topics.angle: Condition-graded used inventory: why a single floor formula fails across conditions and how to reprice aging used stock toward liquidation without losing money.

topics.title: How to Win an eBay Price War Without Going Broke
topics.angle: What to do when two competitors keep undercutting each other: how a hard floor lets you compete on the listings worth winning and walk away from the rest.

topics.title: Bulk Price Editing on eBay vs. Automated Repricing
topics.angle: Why eBay's bulk-edit and Seller Hub price tools are a manual stopgap, and where rules-based repricing with floors takes over for active inventory.

topics.title: How to Track Competitor Prices on eBay
topics.angle: Manual comp-checking vs. continuous competitor-low tracking; how automated tracking feeds repricing decisions and the price-history data behind them.

topics.title: Floors, MAP, and Minimum Pricing on eBay
topics.angle: How brand MAP policies and your own breakeven floor interact, and how to encode both as a hard floor so repricing never violates either.

topics.title: eBay Repricing for Home, Garden & Tools
topics.angle: Bulky, shipping-heavy home/garden inventory where freight cost dominates the floor and seasonal demand shifts the ceiling.

topics.title: ChannelAdvisor Alternative for eBay Repricing
topics.angle: ChannelAdvisor is enterprise multichannel software with enterprise pricing; position Undercut as the focused, affordable eBay-repricing piece for SMB sellers who don't need the full suite.

topics.title: Sellbrite Alternative for eBay Repricing
topics.angle: Sellbrite is inventory/listing management; clarify it isn't a dedicated repricer and show Undercut as the floor-protected repricing layer alongside or instead of it.

topics.title: StreetPricer vs. Undercut
topics.angle: Head-to-head: StreetPricer's pricing and feature set vs. Undercut's hard-floor, AI-tuned approach at a lower entry price. Factual, fair comparison.

topics.title: Ecomdash Alternative for eBay Sellers
topics.angle: Ecomdash sunset/limited repricing context; position Undercut as a current, eBay-focused repricing option for sellers migrating away.

topics.title: Repricing Frequency
topics.angle: Define repricing frequency, why interval length matters for time-at-top-of-search, and the tradeoffs across daily, 15-minute, and 5-minute cycles.

topics.title: Competitor Low Price
topics.angle: Define the competitor-low signal a repricer tracks, how it's sourced from live listings, and how it drives the undercut decision against the floor.

topics.title: Ceiling Price
topics.angle: Define a ceiling price in repricing, when to set one, and how it prevents overpricing when competitors disappear or run out of stock.

topics.title: AI Repricing
topics.angle: Define AI-assisted repricing, how an aggressiveness model differs from a fixed undercut rule, and why a floor still bounds every AI decision.

topics.title: inkFrog Is Shutting Down — What eBay Sellers Should Do Next
topics.angle: A practical checklist for inkFrog sellers facing the shutdown: what to export, what breaks first (listing templates vs. repricing), and how to pick a replacement without a gap in coverage.

topics.title: How to Migrate From inkFrog to a New eBay Repricer
topics.angle: Step-by-step migration mechanics — reconnecting eBay OAuth, re-importing listings, rebuilding floor rules — framed for someone doing this once under deadline pressure, not a power user.

topics.title: inkFrog Shutdown: Every Alternative Compared
topics.angle: A neutral roundup of where displaced inkFrog sellers are going (listing tools vs. dedicated repricers), positioning Undercut specifically for the repricing half of what inkFrog did.

topics.title: eBay Repricing for Liquidation & Pallet Resellers
topics.angle: High-SKU-count, low-per-item-margin liquidation sellers: why floors matter more (thin margins) and how bulk import handles hundreds of one-off SKUs.

topics.title: eBay Repricing for Vintage & Collectibles
topics.angle: Thin, inconsistent comps for one-of-a-kind vintage items — when automated repricing helps (multi-unit collectibles) vs. when it doesn't (true one-offs), set honestly.

topics.title: eBay Seller Hub Pricing Tools vs. Dedicated Repricing Software
topics.angle: What eBay's built-in Seller Hub pricing suggestions actually do (and don't), and where a dedicated floor-protected repricer picks up the slack.

topics.title: 5 Signs You Need eBay Repricing Software
topics.angle: Concrete symptoms (losing Buy Box-equivalent placement, manual price-checking eating hours, margin erosion) that signal it's time to automate, with a free-tier starting point.

topics.title: Hard Price Floor
topics.angle: Define a hard price floor precisely, how it differs from a soft/advisory minimum, and why the floor being unconditionally enforced (not just a default) is the safety property that matters.

topics.title: eBay Buy Box Equivalent (Best Match Placement)
topics.angle: Explain how eBay's Best Match ranking rewards competitive pricing similar to Amazon's Buy Box, and why repricing speed affects placement, not just the sale.

topics.title: Undercut Amount
topics.angle: Define the undercut amount/increment a repricer uses below the competitor low, fixed-cent vs. percentage approaches, and how it interacts with the floor.
